title: handleSendEmail uses stale callFlow('dcfg_flow_send_email_url') instead of createDocumentRequest
detail: Line 348: `await callFlow('dcfg_flow_send_email_url', { to, subject, body, reminderDays })`. Line 15 imports callFlow from portalApi â€” which still exists but is marked legacy per engineering journal Â§5 (DocGen/DMS migrated to the dcfg_document_requests transaction pattern). SendQueue is the only in-scope consumer of callFlow besides the cataloged interviewGenerate.js (CR-0006). On a Prod env where dcfg_flow_send_email_url config row isn't populated, line 348 throws â€” caught by the `catch {}` at line 355 which fakes success toast `'Email action logged (flow unavailable)'`. Silent misreport; user thinks the email went, nothing happens.
recommendedFix: Replace with `await createDocumentRequest({ requestType: DocRequestType.Email, requestedBy: user?.email, name: 'Email: ' + emailModal.subject, contractId: emailModal.contractId || null, notes: JSON.stringify({ to, subject, body, reminderDays }) });`. Update the email flow to trigger on dcfg_document_requests row with requestType=Email. Replace the silent-fallback catch with an honest toast.show('err', 'Email request failed â€” ' + e.message).

title: SendQueue loadAll fires 5 unbounded queries at mount â€” contracts/msas have no $top
detail: Lines 109-114: contracts query (line 110), msas query (line 111), customers query (line 112), onboardingCases query (line 113), wipContracts query (line 114) all lack $top caps. customers filter by active only, onboarding filters by status, wipContracts filters by status+active. But contracts has only an $orderby (no filter) and msas has only $orderby+$expand. Same pattern as SalesDashboard CR-0272. The dashboard page is the SendQueue so this is the highest-traffic landing page in the SPA â€” every admin session hits all 5 queries.
recommendedFix: Add `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true` to the contracts query. Add `$filter=statecode eq 0` to the msas query. Add `$top=500` to both as safety caps. Defer non-critical queries (onboarding, wip) until after initial render.

title: Hardcoded email addresses `team@decades-cg.com` / `compliance@decades-cg.com` in handleRequestInfo templates
detail: Line 320: `to: 'team@decades-cg.com'` â€” hardcoded sales team email. Line 332: email body includes `compliance@decades-cg.com` as a literal. These should come from dcfg_configs (e.g. `dcfg_email_ops_team`, `dcfg_email_compliance`) so the operator can change them without a SPA deploy.
recommendedFix: Add two dcfg_configs rows. Read via getEnvVar with fallbacks to the current hardcoded values. Update the email template to interpolate them.
